thoughts.sr: Građanski senzori prijavljuju 52 instrumenta, što je zapremina koja premašuje SEPA-jeva 32 instrumenta za gotovo pola, iako zvanične stanice ne pokazuju porast vrednosti unatoč pretpostavljenom buku. [F10]
thoughts.en: Citizen sensors report 52 instruments [F10], a volume exceeding SEPA's 32 instruments by nearly half, yet official stations show no surge in values despite perceived noise.
hypotheses: maybe citizen sensors amplify data because they lack calibration filters like SEPA does
perhaps the high headline count on B92 and Cenzolovka reflects a specific event not yet in official air quality reports
questions: what is the correlation between sensor counts and headline volume for similar events?
are citizen sensors filtering out background noise while SEPA stations are saturated?
hypotheses_sr: možda građanski senzori pojačavaju podatke jer nemaju kalibracione filtere kao što ih ima SEPA
možda visok broj naslova na B92 i Cenzolovka odražava specifičan događaj koji još nije u zvaničnim izveštajima o kvalitetu vazduha
questions_sr: kako je korelacija između broja senzora i volumena naslova za slične događaje?
da li građanski senzori filtruju pozadinski buku dok su SEPA stanice zasićene?
thoughts.next_check: check if citizen sensor values correlate with news headlines about air quality
